#662 · Ember Pokémon

Fletchinder

Fire Flying

Kalos · Generation 6

Fletchinder is a Fire/Flying-type Ember Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 16 kg. It evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame. Its highest base stat is Speed (84), with a base stat total of 382.
